description: The maxmind vendor module (SID_MODULES=geo,maxmind, mode fill, the default): the country for the client IP from MaxMind's GeoLite2 Country database, downloaded with the deployer's licence key and built in at build time, as ortb2.device.geo.country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, type 2) with ipservice 3 (MaxMind, AdCOM 1.0 List: IP Location Services). The suite's build has the fixture table the package ships with, which knows only documentation addresses: 192.0.2.0/25 FR, 192.0.2.128/25 XK (no alpha-3 code), 198.51.100.0/24 JP, 203.0.113.0/24 BR, 2001:db8::/48 FR, 2001:db8:1::/48 JP. In fill mode it sends a country only when the platform gives the geo module none; replace always sends it. Requests carry the client IP as X-Forwarded-For (with SID_TRUST_PROXY) and CF-Connecting-IP (Workers), and the CDN's country as cf-ipcountry.

cases.name: fills in the country, with ipservice 3, when the CDN has none
fills in the country for an IPv6 address
leaves the CDN's country alone, with no ipservice
returns nothing for an address the database doesn't know
sends the country with Global Privacy Control and for a COPPA request
